item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 reporting showing Kishida appointing family members, close friends, donors, or business associates to cabinet or key executive posts. I also found no clean evidence of an opaque foundation, hidden staffing channel, or direct yes-man patronage network tied personally to Kishida.
